listings.description: Oud Al Hazrat is not just a fragrance — it is a statement. Born from the rich traditions of Arabian perfumery and reimagined for the modern visionary, this is a scent that carries history, power, and undeniable character in every drop. It opens with a sharp, electrifying burst of lemon and geranium, cut through with the bold heat of black pepper and cardamom — an opening that is daring, confident, and impossible to ignore. As the top notes settle, the heart reveals a sophisticated blend of floral and woody accords that speak to timeless elegance. The fragrance evolves gracefully, building layers of complexity that reward those who wear it with depth and intrigue. This is not a fragrance for the faint-hearted — it demands presence and commands respect. The base anchors the composition with rich oud, warm amber, and creamy sandalwood, creating a lasting impression that lingers on skin and fabric alike. Each note has been carefully selected to create a harmonious journey from opening to dry-down, ensuring that Oud Al Hazrat remains memorable long after the first spray. Perfect for those who understand that fragrance is more than scent — it is identity, heritage, and aspiration combined into one powerful expression.
